metrics.complete_acceptance: accepted complete task outputs / all completed outputs for same frozen task set; separate model from deterministic methods
metrics.false_acceptance: incorrect canaries accepted / incorrect canaries reviewed
metrics.false_rejection: correct controls rejected / correct controls reviewed
metrics.lifecycle: five-label confusion matrix; manual oracle is not model prediction
metrics.latency: wall and inference server separately; no fabricated token counts

independence_policy: All development exposure grouped by source family. No neural holdout certification from repository novelty. Family reserved for evaluation-only until first generation or tool tuning; no evaluation material enters training. Generator does not approve gold. Separate evidence reconstruction required before SOURCE_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE. No owner approval inferred.

hypotheses.text: The newly added shallow clones support bounded API/architecture candidates, but cannot establish lifecycle MODIFY from HEAD versus unavailable parent. Measure unavailable-parent abstention separately.
Revision-rich alternatives can support measured architecture-relevant changes; choose by actual diff and exposure, not directory.
Separating declarative schema facts from runtime guarantees reduces false acceptance on bilingual architecture claims.

external_actions: read-only Git metadata and selected licensed public source; no commands from external projects
private_policy: metadata only in shared artifacts; private source stays out of model requests, datasets and public reports
